comment: D1 singles arm: detsim against the stock NOvA ND simulation on the same HepEVT electrons. Declared 2026-11-21 after the 20-electron smoke test of the stock dump and before any detsim-vs-stock comparison was computed. Collaboration data (the stock arm and every result) stay private; this file and the code are public. The record carries this file's sha256.

sample.electrons: the S26-07-01 replay electrons (nu-on-e kinematics from the production overlay, spill-distributed times), chunks ovl_chunk_0000-0019, 1000 each
sample.stock: testrel_tfgnt (base S26-07-01): TextFileGenNT -> G4 + photon transport + readout (ovl_replay_gen.fcl) -> prod_ldm_full_nd_datamc_prod5p1 reco + CAF, with D1HitDump in the reco process
sample.detsim: novafastsim_detsim on the private ND description (nova-fastsim-inputs nova/detector/nd_S26-07-01.json), the same HepEVT rows through particles.from_hepevt, expected response and one sampled readout per event
sample.event_selection: vertex in the main detector, away from its faces: |x| < 170 cm, |y| < 170 cm, 20 cm < z < 1250 cm (detsim has no muon catcher yet), and true electron energy 0.1-10 GeV
sample.split: chunks 0-9 train (calibration fits only), chunks 10-19 test (every scored comparison)

L1_deposits.what: the deposit model and the ND geometry, independent of light and electronics
L1_deposits.stock: sim::FLSHit energies summed per (plane, cell): Edep and EdepBirks

histograms.escint_frac: per event: scintillator Edep / E_true, 40 bins over [0, 1]
histograms.birks_ratio: per event: EdepBirks / Edep, 40 bins over [0.9, 1.0]
histograms.ncells: per event: cells with Edep > 0.5 MeV, 50 bins over [0, 500]
histograms.long_profile: Edep summed over events against (plane - vertex plane) in units of planes, 0-120, normalised per event to E_true (values with errors from the event-to-event spread)
histograms.lat_profile: Edep summed against |cell - energy-weighted mean cell of the event in that view|, 0-30 cells, same normalisation

L2_response.what: light yield, attenuation, quenching and readout threshold in the ND
L2_response.stock: cell hits with BackTracker true energy > 0 (signal hits); hits without are noise and are reported separately, not scored (detsim has no noise hits)
L2_response.detsim: one sampled readout per event (Hits: pe, hit), with the train-fitted optics
L2_response.fit_on_train: optics.yield_per_mev, and frac_short / atten_short / atten_long, by least squares on the train chunks' profile of signal-hit PE per MeV of true Birks energy against distance to the readout (10 cm bins); APD and threshold parameters at their defaults

histograms.nsig_hits: per event: signal hits, 50 bins over [0, 500]
histograms.pe_per_mev_vs_dist: signal-hit PE / true Birks MeV against distance to the readout, 0-400 cm in 20 cm bins (values with errors)
histograms.hit_pe: signal-hit PE spectrum, 60 log bins over [5, 5000]
histograms.sig_pe_frac: per event: total signal PE / E_true (PE per GeV), 50 bins over the train range

L3_reco.what: the stand-in reco against the collaboration reconstruction
L3_reco.stock: LDMDump of the CAFs: calorimetric energy, shower direction, E theta^2 of the leading shower
L3_reco.detsim: reco.energy and reco.theta2 on the sampled readout
L3_reco.status: scored once LDMDump has run on the CAFs; same splits and statistics

statistics.counts: hep-simbench mode same_events (both arms on the same events): chi2 = sum (n1 - n2)^2 / (n1 + n2)
statistics.profiles: hep-simbench values: errors from the event-to-event spread of each arm, combined
statistics.flag: chi2/ndf > 2 and p < 1e-3 (no reseeded-stock floor exists for this sample)

pass_lines.deposits_validated: every L1 histogram unflagged in float32 and float64
pass_lines.response_validated: every L2 histogram unflagged on the test chunks, in both floats
pass_lines.dtype_agreement: float32 and float64 detsim give the same flags
